The '''Extrictarium Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located within the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] sector in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], between the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] and the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], but did not appear on any starcharts. It contained the legendary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. [[Ailyn Vel]] killed [[Spar|Alpha-Ø2]] in the nebula.
